recognize_zh: 低倍血片中淋巴細胞明顯增多，多為中型、核不規則有凹陷或切跡、細胞質少至中量淡藍，比典型「臀部細胞（buttock cell）」更大、染色質較開放，符合型態非典型的周邊血液化濾泡性淋巴瘤。
features: Marked absolute lymphocytosis with numerous atypical lymphoid cells in a low-power field
Cells small-to-intermediate, many larger than typical small lymphocytes
Nuclei irregular with notches, clefts or indentations; some angulated
Chromatin moderately condensed to somewhat open; nucleoli inconspicuous at this power
Scant-to-moderate pale blue cytoplasm; background red cells largely normocytic with few smudge-like forms
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at low power shows a marked lymphocytosis composed of small-to-intermediate atypical lymphoid cells with irregular, notched and focally cleaved nuclei, moderately condensed chromatin and scant-to-moderate pale blue cytoplasm. Many cells are larger and less condensed than the classic small cleaved buttock cells of follicular lymphoma. Red cells are largely unremarkable and platelets are present. Findings are suggestive of leukemic involvement by a B-cell lymphoma with atypical morphology, consistent with peripheralizing follicular lymphoma in the appropriate context; flow cytometry (CD10+, CD5-, bright sIg) and t(14;18) IGH::BCL2 testing are recommended.

ddx.vs: MCL cells have similar irregular nuclei but are CD5+, CD10-, cyclin D1/SOX11 positive with t(11;14).
CLL cells are round-nucleated with soccer-ball chromatin and smudge cells, and are CD5/CD23 positive with dim sIg.
Sézary cells have cerebriform grooved nuclei and ATLL cells have flower-like lobation, both with a CD4+ T-cell phenotype.

ddx.dx: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma in blood
ddx.vs: Leukemic DLBCL shows larger cells with vesicular chromatin, prominent nucleoli and abundant basophilic cytoplasm.
